study.title: A Phase 3, Randomized Study of Dual Immunotherapy in Advanced NSCLC
study.headline: Forecast DBL delay: 6 days. Driven primarily by safety reconciliation (35%), delayed central laboratory transfer (30%), and ageing critical queries (22%).

primaryDrivers.summary: 2 unresolved SAE discrepancies at Site 104 blocking pharmacovigilance safety freeze.
Batch #LXB-8921 (ctDNA panel) checksum failure awaiting vendor QA re-export.
14 critical queries aged >14 days affecting RECIST tumor restaging at Sites 104 & 317.
18 case report books completed but awaiting PI electronic signatures.

dimensions.name: Safety Reconciliation
dimensions.details: 2 SAE discordances between Rave EDC and Argus Safety. 1 death narrative unconfirmed.

dimensions.name: External Data Readiness
dimensions.details: LabCorp ctDNA batch #LXB-8921 failed MD5 hash. Eurofins chemistry batch in QA review.

dimensions.name: Query Resolution
dimensions.details: 68 total open queries. 14 critical queries aged >14 days on primary efficacy forms.

dimensions.name: SDV / SDR & Sign-offs
dimensions.details: SDV 93% complete. 18 PI sign-offs remaining at Sites 104, 317 and 405.

dimensions.name: Medical Coding
dimensions.details: MedDRA 27.0 and WHODrug Global C3 dictionary auto-coding running at 97.4%. 12 terms pending manual coder review.

dimensions.name: EDC Completeness
dimensions.details: 94% visits entered within 5 days SLA. 12 non-critical eCRF forms pending data entry.

actions.title: Resolve 2 SAE Discrepancies at Site 104
actions.rationale: Safety reconciliation is the #1 blocker on the critical DBL path. Reconciling SUBJ-104-003 (CRS onset) and SUBJ-104-012 (Death narrative) unfreezes safety database lock.
actions.proposedPlan: Convene joint CRA/Safety teleconference with PI Dr. Vance to align on medical records onset date (Oct 12) and update Argus case causality narrative.
actions.decisionOwnership: Human Governed (Safety Lead approval required under 21 CFR Part 11)

actions.title: Escalate Overdue LabCorp ctDNA Transfer (#LXB-8921)
actions.rationale: Transfer is 4 days overdue due to SFTP checksum failure. Affects biomarker secondary endpoint for 48 subjects across Sites 104 and 317.
actions.proposedPlan: Issue formal vendor escalation protocol; authorize emergency manual SFTP pickup with real-time SHA-256 verification hash.

actions.title: Prioritize 5 Ageing RECIST Primary Endpoint Queries
actions.rationale: Queries directly impact Progression-Free Survival (PFS) primary endpoint data at Sites 104 and 317.
actions.proposedPlan: Deploy CRA on-site data cleaning support for 2 consecutive days at Boston site to close RECIST worksheets directly with radiology coordinators.

actions.title: Execute Targeted CRA Strike Team at Site 104
actions.rationale: Site 104 closure velocity (1.4/day) is inadequate for planned LSLV freeze.
actions.proposedPlan: Deploy senior contract monitor to complete 100% SDV of remaining locked forms and support PI sign-off queue.

interventions.title: Resolve all SAE reconciliation discrepancies (Site 104)
interventions.description: Align Argus Case #PV-2026-9812 with Rave eCRF and confirm hospice death certificate narrative for SUBJ-104-012.

interventions.title: Receive and ingest delayed LabCorp ctDNA transfer (#LXB-8921)
interventions.description: Receive re-packaged FASTQ ctDNA dataset via secure SFTP and complete auto-reconciliation against 48 subject samples.

interventions.title: Deploy specialized CRA data-cleaning strike team to Site 104 for 5 days
interventions.description: Increase query closure velocity from 1.4 to 4.5/day, clearing all 14 ageing EDC queries.

interventions.title: Prioritize Site 317 RECIST primary tumor scan restaging queries
interventions.description: Resolve motion artifact query with BioClinica imaging adjudicator for SUBJ-317-005.

interventions.title: Automate bulk PI electronic re-signatures for clean visits
interventions.description: Trigger electronic batch signature workflow for 18 completed and fully monitored case books.

forecastScenarios.assumptions: Critical interventions (SAE recon + LabCorp transfer) executed within 48 hours. Zero new SAE reports emerging post-LSLV. Query closure velocity hits 4.2/day across all sites.
Current team velocity continues. SAE discrepancy resolved by Nov 03. LabCorp transfer ingested Nov 02. Minor routine queries burn down within 7 days.
Site 104 PI unavailable during Thanksgiving week. Vendor transfer fails second checksum verification. Secondary RECIST adjudication requires scan repeat.

closedLoopOutcomes.recommendation: Deploy CRA query sweep to Site 208 for 41 routine queries
closedLoopOutcomes.actualOutcome: 32 minor con-med queries resolved in 48 hours. Query burn-down accelerated by 2.4x.
closedLoopOutcomes.learningCaptured: Demonstrated that routine query volume does not stall DBL when CRA focus is applied; validated that Site 208 was a low critical-path risk despite high volume.

closedLoopOutcomes.recommendation: Automated MedDRA 27.0 dictionary bulk re-coding for concomitant medications
closedLoopOutcomes.actualOutcome: 142 verbatim terms auto-coded with 100% confidence. Zero medical uncoded queries remaining on critical path.
closedLoopOutcomes.learningCaptured: Confirmed zero critical path delay contribution from medical coding; shifted team focus entirely to safety and lab data.

closedLoopOutcomes.actualOutcome: Eurofins committed senior lab supervisor; calibration logs provided.
closedLoopOutcomes.learningCaptured: Automated vendor notification reduced sponsor response time from 3.2 days to 4 hours.
